title: Sky trail through clouds near Harmon Field, Newfoundland (Fig. 5)
description: Photograph, mounted sideways on the page, of a cloudy sky with a dark diagonal trail descending from the top, a small dark mark near the centre, power lines, a utility pole and tree tops along the bottom. Labelled "Fig. 5" in the margin with photo number "34923 A.C." at lower right. Associated with the 10 July 1947 Woodruff sighting.
